_comment: Deliberately ambiguous. Expected: RCS <= 60, multiple high/critical findings across definitional_ambiguity and timing_ambiguity.
question: Will US GDP growth exceed 2% in 2025?
resolution_criteria: This market resolves YES if US GDP growth exceeds 2% in 2025. Resolution will be based on official government data. The market closes at end of year.
known_vulnerabilities: 'exceeds' is ambiguous — strictly greater than vs greater than or equal to
GDP not specified as real vs nominal
No specification of advance vs revised estimate
No fallback if BEA page URL changes
